messages:
alice: Quick follow-up from the DR postmortem — we want a short tracker for game-day readiness and recurring patterns. Can owners confirm timelines for the items below?

ben: I can take multi-region routing checks. Plan: run traffic-shift drill next Tuesday during low traffic window.

carla: I'll own backups/restore runbook updates. Will add a checklist and the S3 retention validation steps.

deepak: I'll do a pass on the automatic failover policy and routing policy preferences (latency vs cost).

emily: I'll coordinate the game-day schedule, invite infra + SRE, and add a post-game survey.

alice: Thanks. Key items to capture in the checklist:
- routing smoke test (control-plane and dataplane)
- cold restore from latest full backup + wal replay validation
- KV cache warmup procedure
- fallback model variant routing (if GPU pool unavailable)

ben: Proposed routing smoke test snippet (run from mgmt host):
```bash
# send test request to regional lb, then to fallback region
curl -s -X POST https://control.redwood.internal/test-shift -d '{"target_region":"us-west-2"}'
# verify traces show path via us-west-2
```

carla: Backup locations: s3://redwood-prod-backups/full/ and s3://redwood-prod-backups/wal/. I'll add retention and integrity check commands to run weekly. Example check: `aws s3 ls s3://redwood-prod-backups/full/ --recursive | head`

deepak: For automatic failover, we noted two recurring patterns:
1) KV cache miss storm after failover causing latency surge
2) Model quantized variant mismatch causing inference errors when routing to cheaper pool
We should add mitigations to runbook: cache pre-warm hook and model-compatibility checks.

alice: Ownership & timelines then:
- ben: routing drills + smoke test script by 1777773600 (end of next week)
- carla: full runbook + restore checklist by 1777697200 (two days) -- include exact commands and estimated restore RTO
- deepak: failover policy changes + pre-warm hook design by 1777860000 (10 days)
- emily: schedule + invites by 1777771800 (1.5 hours)

ben: noted. I'll add the route test to infra-ci as a canary job. If it fails, infra-bot should open an incident ticket.

ops-bot: infra-ci canary job created: `canary/dr-routing-smoke` scheduled weekly. Failure -> creates ticket in #incidents.

carla: For restore runbook, draft snippet I'm adding to the doc: 
```text
1) stop write traffic to cluster A
2) restore latest full backup from s3://redwood-prod-backups/full/yyyy-mm-dd
3) apply WAL from s3://redwood-prod-backups/wal/yyyy-mm-dd/*
4) run `restore-validate --checks=integrity,consistency`
5) run KV pre-warm script: `kv-warm --source=replica`
6) switch traffic via control plane with gradual 10% steps
```
I'll include estimated timings for each step.

deepak: For the model variant issue, I'll add a pre-deploy compatibility test to the model onboarding CI that asserts tokenization/ops match between variants. Also adding a fallback mapping table in routing config: `fallback_map.json`.

alice: Good. Let's also track recurrence indicators in the postmortem board: spike in cache misses, restore failures, unexpected model errors. Emily, add those as tags in the invite so on-call knows to capture metrics.

emily: Will do. Also adding a quick survey question for game-day: "Did warmup complete before traffic shift? Y/N" and "Any unexpected errors? paste logs".

ben: One more note — during previous regional failover we saw DNS TTLs block quick switchover. I'll add a TTL-check step and a suggestion to lower TTL to 30s during game-day.

carla: Adding TTL step and example command: `dig +noall +answer lb.redwood.api | awk '{print $2" "$5}'` to inspect TTL.

alice: OK team — we'll sync in the game-day channel at start, run these checks, and converge post-game to close action items. Please update the tracker doc with links to your PRs and CI jobs. I'll follow up in two days for status. :calendar: :white_check_mark:

emily: Invite sent to #incidents, #eng-sre, #eng-infra and product ops. Calendar slot: next Tue 03:00 UTC (low traffic).

deepak: Quick question — for the KV pre-warm, do we prefer passive replica read or replay of hot keys? I vote for replica read to avoid hammering primary.

carla: replica read + gradual ramp. I'll document the exact commands.

ben: I'll ping CDN team about TTL change window.

alice: Thanks everyone. Marking this thread as the action tracker for game-day readiness — comment here when you PR or create CI job so I can tick off items.

carla: PR for runbook updates: https://git.redwood/repo/docs/pull/412 (draft).

ben: routing canary job: https://ci.redwood/jobs/2345 (created).

deepak: fallback_map.json added at https://git.redwood/repo/infra/commit/abc123.

emily: Calendar + invites done.

alice: Last check — timeline sanity: last_message_ts 1777770620. I'll run remind in 48h if not closed.

ben: :thumbsup:
